summary: Comprehensive test suite with clear TDD structure across 7 iterations covering parsing (XML/JSON), aggregation, flaky detection, and markdown/JSON rendering. Excellent requirement coverage including full workflow integration through `act`. Strong error handling tests (missing files, malformed input, unsupported formats). Good end-to-end validation with parametrized act cases (flaky-matrix, all-green) that verify exact expected values and negative assertions. Workflow tests include actionlint validation and job success tracking. Minor gaps: some boundary conditions untested (empty result sets, special characters in test names, tests appearing only in one file), and the `_act_session_started` list pattern for cross-test state is brittle. Fixture files referenced but not shown (assumed present per prompt constraints). Overall would reliably catch regressions in core functionality and workflow behavior.
